"On the question of the officer needing rescue: video shows he was able to move away from the crowd on his own within seconds.  The police did not use pepper spray for another 4 minutes and 40 seconds from the moment he fell.  HTTPURL"

"On the question of the officer needing evacuation: video shows the officer participated in an arrest after he fell. He walked away from the scene. Paramedics say they did not evacuate him; police then said he was taken by police helicopter to a hospital.  HTTPURL"

"On the question of the crowd being hostile and presenting a danger to the officer: video shows that the crowd moved away immediately on noticing he had fallen. People within and outside the crowd signalled and shouted to one another to move away.  HTTPURL"
